Diuers reaſons are alſo alleaged, why God would reſerue theſe two aliue
Firſt to ſhew by example, that as their mor tal bodies are long conſerued from
corrupting or decaying, in like ſorte Adam and Eue and al others not ſinning
ſhould haue bene conſerued, and according to Gods promiſe, nener haue died:
but after ſome good time tranſlated to heauen, and indued with immortalitie.
Secondly to giue vs an argument of immor tali tie, which is promiſed after the

are riſen againe. Thirdly theſe two ( one of the law of nature, the other of
